pathId and direct are not revisable (direct describes a structural routing fact, not an operator-tunable parameter). Returns 422 if the path is Deactivated — a deactivated path is a closed historical record. A no-op revision (identical matchPrefix and requiredCapabilities) is a successful 200 that does NOT republish ProcessPathUpdated.
